dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It would seem that your writing isn't going too well...

dialogues.speaker: "Bellringer"
dialogues.text: Well, it wasn't, which was why I holed up in this little town, where most people wouldn't find me.

dialogues.speaker: "Bellringer"
dialogues.text: But I had a dream two days ago, one that had a grand, glorious ancient civilization as its stage — like an epic opera.

dialogues.speaker: "Bellringer"
dialogues.text: As such, I plan to write about a young adventurer who discovers an ancient underwater civilization while in pursuit of an enigmatic red gem.

dialogues.speaker: "Bellringer"
dialogues.text: Haha, perhaps we shall simply call it "The Ruby Riddle."
